description: This file defines the Map.TouchZoom handler for the Leaflet library, enabling pinch-zoom functionality on supported mobile browsers within the map component.

classes.name: TouchZoom
classes.description: A handler class extending Leaflet's Handler to add pinch zoom support on mobile browsers.

methods.name: addHooks
methods.description: Initializes the touch zoom handler by adding CSS class and event listeners.

methods.name: removeHooks
methods.description: Removes event listeners and CSS class when handler is deactivated.

methods.name: _onTouchStart
methods.description: Handles the start of a touch event, initializing pinch zoom parameters.

methods.name: _onTouchMove
methods.description: Handles touch move events to perform pinch zoom calculations and map zooming.

methods.name: _onTouchEnd
methods.description: Finalizes the pinch zoom operation, applying zoom or resetting view.
